concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium Roblox flying battle mount concept art FOR USER APPROVAL, not an actual gameplay screenshot or finished model.
Create one beautiful landscape 3:2 art-direction sheet with a very large expressive three-quarter side view of this flying mount occupying the upper 75%, and a restrained bottom strip of three smaller distinct poses showing the proposed animation. Polished stylized 3D collectible-game sculpture, confident chunky faceted geometry, broad readable surfaces, sculpted forms achievable in Blender, dramatic beautiful lighting, tasteful controlled glow. Cool and aspirational for teenage players, not babyish or goofy, not photographic, not over-detailed fantasy MMO realism.
Include a clearly visible generic blocky Roblox-like humanoid pilot sitting astride a physically understandable low saddle on the creature's back between the wing roots, hands on grips, legs on either side. Short dark hair, plain charcoal jacket, light gray pants. The avatar is an approximate placeholder, not claimed to depict the user's real avatar. Pilot is roughly one-third of the creature's body length, visible above its back, never fused into it. Wide wing reach, body compact enough to substitute for a small battle aircraft. Creature, both wings, rider and tail fully inside frame with generous margins. Single mount in hero view, no enemies or weapons; small bottom studies are the same design.
Tasteful deep navy presentation background with subtle lighter atmospheric gradient, crisp silhouette separation, no busy scenery, no currencies, prices, shop buttons, logos or watermark. Simple legible typography only: supplied title and 'LEGENDARY • MOUNT CONCEPT'; bottom labels only as specified. Concept motion should be communicated by different clear wing poses, not multiple overlapping ghost limbs. This is a still artwork visualizing future animation.

Primary request: STORMCROWN EAGLE, an organic, majestic, intensely cool giant bald eagle mount. Instantly recognizable bold snowy-white head and white tail, powerful hooked golden yellow beak, fierce amber eye, deep chocolate/charcoal brown feathered body. Broad wings with 6-8 oversized clearly separated sculpted primary feather groups and readable layered feather shapes; avoid tiny noisy feather texture. This is a living eagle, not a robot, not a dragon. Two golden talons tucked naturally beneath chest in flight. Restrained gold saddle hardware, dark fitted saddle. Very subtle cyan lightning threads only at the outermost two feathers of each wing; a few short warm golden feather sparks. White head and dark body carry the silhouette even with VFX removed. Hero pose mid strong downstroke with wings stretching sideways and slightly down, head lifted proudly, rider leaning into flight. No literal crown, national flags or patriotic symbols. Lighting warms the white feathers and gold beak, blue rim light separates dark wings. Bottom studies demonstrate wings raised for UPSTROKE, wings broad for GLIDE, then wings angled back for DIVE, keep rider visible.
Exact title: '01  STORMCROWN EAGLE'. Bottom exact labels: 'UPSTROKE', 'GLIDE', 'DIVE'.

Primary request: IRONWING EAGLE, a striking mechanical bald eagle battle mount, clearly designed as a white-headed eagle rather than a generic fighter jet. White ceramic armored eagle head, expressive narrow amber optics, gold hooked beak, midnight navy compact body, beautifully chunky articulated wing panels arranged as separated geometric primary feathers with dark joints and selective glowing orange seams. Restrained brushed gold edging, burnt orange low-intensity vents. Organic bird proportions translated into a premium toy mech, jointed flapping wings with clear shoulder and wrist mechanisms; folded metal talons beneath body. Pilot seated in an OPEN dorsal saddle, torso and head visible, no enclosure. Hero pose banking slightly toward the camera with a strong fully spread wing silhouette, no missiles or firearms. Make it tactile and buildable, not a dense pile of tiny mechanical parts or glowing lines. Bottom studies show lift of wings UPSTROKE, sweeping powered DOWNSTROKE, and wings partly folded into a streamlined DIVE. All poses are same mechanical eagle and seated rider.
Exact title: '02  IRONWING EAGLE'. Bottom exact labels: 'UPSTROKE', 'DOWNSTROKE', 'DIVE'.

Primary request: ECLIPSE PHOENIX, an epic phoenix flying battle mount with obsidian violet sculpted feathers, a bright sharp gold-orange face/beak, elegantly swept crown-like natural crest of exactly three large feathers, massive wings whose broad primary feather tips transition to molten orange and saturated magenta ember light. Tail three bold long ribbonlike feather forms trailing behind, never a cloud of messy fire. An appealing bold head silhouette distinct from the eagle. Proud, fierce and elegant, with a small dark saddle and visible seated blocky rider clearly separated from the creature's neck. The phoenix is a solid riggable creature with controlled glowing edges; large solid feather groups carry all shapes, not a shapeless particle bird. Hero moment broad downward wing beat, very few floating embers, gold-orange key light and violet rim light. Lower strip shows wings lifted UPSTROKE, broad GLIDE, and a celebratory wings-up VICTORY flare, with rider attached in every pose.
Exact title: '03  ECLIPSE PHOENIX'. Bottom exact labels: 'UPSTROKE', 'GLIDE', 'VICTORY'.

Primary request: RIFT MANTA, an original epic airborne cosmic manta-ray battle mount, graceful and slightly predatory with a strong unmistakable manta silhouette. Compact broad inky midnight-blue and indigo body, smooth satin sculpted surface with just a few luminous turquoise bioluminescent markings, pale cool mint underside visible on curled leading wing edge, two small forward cephalic fins framing a sleek head, small bright gold eyes. Two huge thick triangular ray wings forming a powerful swept diamond silhouette, broad simple fin forms with gently curved tips; long slim tail with a tiny violet glowing diamond end. Short restrained violet and cyan wingtip wakes. Visible blocky avatar straddles a low fitted saddle on the central back, legs on each side, never standing or surfing. Main pose soars gracefully in three-quarter side view with the far wing lifted and near wing curling downward to demonstrate undulating flap action. It flies through air, no underwater bubbles, no shark teeth, no dragon limbs, no mechanical engines. Bottom studies show the same ray and pilot with wings raised CREST, wings dipped SWEEP, then level fins GLIDE. Emphasis on captivating elegant movement and an exceptionally clean silhouette readable at small sizes.
Exact title: '04  RIFT MANTA'. Bottom exact labels: 'CREST', 'SWEEP', 'GLIDE'.
